findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added to its superclass UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) at UsernamePasswordForm.java:160. There is no no-arg overload, so this file will fail compilation and the PR cannot build.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are now disabled on the initial login page
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) now requires user != null, and authenticate() at line 115 and challenge(context,error,field) at line 137 use it to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context). On a first (non-re-authentication) login the user is not yet identified, so context.getUser() is null, fillContextForm is never called, and the ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI attribute, challenge and RP data are not set on the login form. This breaks discoverable/passkey-first login where the credential itself identifies the user, e.g. the existing webauthnLoginWithDiscoverableKey tests that expect automatic passkey login from the initial UsernamePasswordForm page. The condition should remain based on passkeys being enabled, with shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators() (now overridden to false for conditional UI) preventing display of a per-user authenticator list.
